findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler but only contains `pass`. StatefulDetectorHandler declares `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the new `build_occurrence_and_event_data` as abstract methods, so instantiating MetricAlertDetectorHandler will raise TypeError. Detector.detector_handler calls `MetricAlertDetectorHandler(self)` for detectors whose type resolves to MetricAlertFire, turning the previous concrete no-op handler into a runtime failure. Implement the required methods or keep the handler concrete.

findings.title: Expected occurrence is built with a different group key
findings.body: In TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe, `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` is called with `"val1"`, but `expected_result` and `evaluate_group_key_value` use `"group_key"`. The helper builds the occurrence fingerprint from the supplied group key, so the expected occurrence will not match the result produced for `"group_key"` (or, if equality ignores the fingerprint, the test fails to verify the key-specific fingerprint). Build the expected occurrence with `"group_key"`.

findings.title: Test helper passes a GroupType class as IssueOccurrence.type
findings.body: `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` sets `type=handler.detector.group_type`, but `IssueOccurrence.type` is the integer group type id. Since every occurrence in these tests is built by the same helper, the tests will not catch an invalid occurrence type, and any path that serializes or validates the occurrence will see a malformed payload. Pass `handler.detector.group_type.type_id` instead.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The return type of `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` changed from `list[DetectorEvaluationResult]` to `dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]`, but the docstring still says it returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`. This misleads implementers and callers about the new contract.
